records.name: Perspective bearer attribution
records.target: Determine which specified entity, component or interaction bears the configuration responsible for a declared response distinction.
records.excludes: Assigning consciousness, goals or all downstream effects to the named component.
records.start: A hormone, gene, cell or agent response is described without locating the responsible configuration.
records.operation: Fix the response distinction; compare candidate bearers; specify which components each contains; vary or remove a component in the stated causal account; identify which attribution explains the retained and lost distinctions.
records.end: A scoped attribution or competing attributions with a distinguishing intervention.
records.case: Holding hormone identity fixed while varying the receiving configuration separates ligand identity from the whole response arrangement.
records.finding: One causal episode can support different bearer attributions for different explanatory targets.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective response sensitivity
records.target: Determine which specified input or context changes alter an identified bearer response under declared comparison conditions.
records.excludes: The bearer consciously noticing the difference or its response being beneficial.
records.start: Conditions treated as equivalent may have different consequences.
records.operation: Fix bearer, observable and interval; specify the input difference; compare the corresponding response relation or observations; record invariance and unavailable comparisons.
records.end: A scoped sensitivity, invariance or unresolved comparison.
records.case: A fixed threshold rule produces different heater states above and below the threshold without acquiring a new rule.
records.finding: Response variation can occur under an unchanged governing configuration.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective response equivalence
records.target: Determine whether two response configurations yield the same specified observable response on every case of a declared domain.
records.excludes: Identity of mechanisms, experience, cost or behavior outside the domain.
records.start: Different descriptions may duplicate the same contribution for the intended comparison.
records.operation: Fix domain and observable; compare each admitted case or supply a valid general argument; return a distinguishing case or the exact equivalence domain; retain missing comparisons.
records.end: A countercase, domain-relative equivalence or unresolved remainder.
records.case: Two lookup tables agree on familiar cases but disagree on an altered wording case.
records.finding: Agreement on the present answer can coexist with different later activation or transfer behavior.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective change locus
records.target: Determine which specified part of a bearer-context arrangement changed between two response episodes.
records.excludes: Attributing improvement, causal sufficiency or intentional revision from the changed result alone.
records.start: A new outcome is called a perspective change without identifying what changed.
records.operation: Compare recorded inputs, bearer state, response rule, available representation, environment and observable definition; identify supported differences and unresolved confounds.
records.end: An identified change location or explicit unresolved alternatives.
records.case: A new input changes an unchanged rule's output; a revised threshold changes the rule; a sensor repair changes access.
records.finding: Input, state, access and rule changes have different implications.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective problem recognition contribution
records.target: Determine how changing a perspective changes which problems are recognized in a fixed presented situation under a fixed relevance standard.
records.excludes: The choice to act on a recognized problem or a difference caused solely by new presented evidence.
records.start: Interpretations make different unresolved matters apparent in the same case.
records.operation: Fix situation and relevance standard; apply the alternative distinctions; state the problem each makes recognizable; identify the condition producing the difference.
records.end: A perspective-dependent recognition contrast with fixed conditions and remaining uncertainty.
records.case: The same failed transfer appears as missing content or missing application-condition recognition.
records.finding: Problem recognition is part of perspective development rather than an invariably correct supplied input.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective subject relevance determination
records.target: Determine what result from a specified subject would contribute to the current matter under an identified perspective and conditions.
records.excludes: Technique selection, truth of the result or relevance inferred only from topic similarity.
records.start: A subject is selected without specifying what its answer changes.
records.operation: Fix the perspective and matter; state the subject determination; compare continuation when its usable result is available with continuation when it is unavailable; where different result contents are admissible, trace their distinct next questions, operations or commitments; identify missing dependencies.
records.end: A conditional relevance relation with an explicit use for materially different results.
records.case: Success after a minimal cue directs inquiry toward recognition; failure reopens missing content or operation.
records.finding: Relevance includes supplying a needed justification or prerequisite even when the expected answer is already clear. Alternative result contents add further conditional contributions.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective study configuration construction
records.target: Construct a system arrangement of specified studies whose results supply identified subsequent contributions under an adopted perspective.
records.excludes: An unordered subject list, automatic truth of outputs or proof of overall effectiveness.
records.start: Necessary studies are known but their order and result uses are unspecified.
records.operation: State each study result and required input; connect results to consumers; order dependencies; assign different result branches distinct continuations; preserve unresolved compatibility.
records.end: A study arrangement with result uses, dependencies and unresolved interfaces.
records.case: A cue observation precedes interpretation of transfer failure and selection of a case contrast or missing-operation study.
records.finding: Selecting subjects does not determine how their contributions are composed.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective result interpretation rule
records.target: Specify how materially different results of an identified study change a perspective, its commitment or its next contribution.
records.excludes: Producing the study result or establishing the interpretation rule's truth.
records.start: An observation is recorded but its consequence for the inquiry is unspecified.
records.operation: Fix the study question and result meanings; assign each result its supported update; include an unresolved-result branch; state assumptions connecting results to updates.
records.end: A result-to-update rule with explicit branches and dependency limits.
records.case: Cue success supports recognition inquiry; cue failure reopens content or operation; an unperformed test leaves both open.
records.finding: Unknown must have its own continuation and must not silently become success or failure.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective transition construction
records.target: Construct an operation intended to make a specified change of perspective available from declared starting conditions.
records.excludes: Merely naming the destination or assuming the operation necessarily succeeds.
records.start: A useful destination is describable but no route to it is supplied.
records.operation: Identify the missing distinction, input or capacity; construct an operation supplying it; specify the observable intermediate result and how it enables the change.
records.end: An operation with starting requirements, an intermediate contribution and a destination condition.
records.case: A matched positive and negative case exposes when an already executable method applies.
records.finding: A transition can first create the conditions needed for a useful perspective.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective transition applicability
records.target: Determine whether the declared requirements of a specified perspective-transition operation hold in identified starting conditions.
records.excludes: Actual transition success, retention or suitability of the destination.
records.start: A previously useful transition is proposed where prerequisites may be missing.
records.operation: List operation requirements; compare them with observations; retain true, false and unknown states; identify which missing condition would enable use.
records.end: Requirements met, a contradicted requirement or explicit unresolved requirements.
records.case: A contrasting-case operation needs accessible cases; knowing its name does not supply them.
records.finding: Creating a prerequisite can change transition applicability.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective transition reachability
records.target: Determine which specified perspectives can be reached through identified transition operations under declared starting conditions and path constraints.
records.excludes: Reachability through unknown operations, successful real execution or a universally optimal route.
records.start: A limited current perspective may enable intermediate routes to a useful one.
records.operation: Fix states, directed transitions and conditions; follow applicable paths; retain paths requiring unresolved conditions separately; distinguish graph-relative absence from general impossibility.
records.end: Reachable paths, conditional paths or a graph-relative absence with its boundary.
records.case: Transfer failure leads through a cue observation and case contrast to an application-condition perspective.
records.finding: A perspective can contribute through its accessible continuations before it supplies the final result.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective improvement retention
records.target: Determine whether a previously established beneficial perspective change remains available for relevant use after a specified interval or transition.
records.excludes: Establishing the original benefit, immediate repetition alone or assuming a saved note is used.
records.start: A useful correction exists but its later availability or use is uncertain.
records.operation: Fix the established contribution and retrieval conditions; inspect a later applicable occasion; determine whether the distinction and operation remain available; separate storage from operative reuse.
records.end: Retained availability or use, loss or unresolved evidence at the declared later occasion.
records.case: A saved instruction survives while a later task still receives the irrelevant operation it was intended to replace.
records.finding: Record persistence and retention of a usable improvement are different determinations.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective formation condition
records.target: Determine which specified conditions make a perspective newly available to an identified bearer or arrangement.
records.excludes: Later activation of an available perspective or universal necessity of one origin.
records.start: A perspective is available but what made it possible is unclear.
records.operation: Fix availability and the prior inventory; compare relevant experience, construction, structure and environmental support; identify supported contributions and alternative origins.
records.end: A scoped formation account or explicit alternative formation conditions.
records.case: A new diagram makes a dependency distinction available before anyone chooses to use it.
records.finding: Formation can depend on conditions external to the eventual bearer.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective activation trigger
records.target: Identify which event or condition brings an available perspective into operative use in a declared context.
records.excludes: Its construction, conscious choice or suitability for the context.
records.start: A useful perspective exists but does not become operative when needed.
records.operation: Fix the available perspective; compare cues or context changes; identify the consequential distinction or action; preserve uncertainty about causal attribution.
records.end: A trigger with an observable adoption consequence and scope, or an unresolved attribution.
records.case: Familiar wording activates a method while different wording conceals the same governing relation.
records.finding: An activation cue can be narrower than the perspective's application domain.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective adoption commitment
records.target: Specify the scope and degree of reliance assigned to an interpretation in a particular inquiry or action.
records.excludes: Evidence-warranted confidence or commitment attributed to every physical bearer.
records.start: A temporary assumption is becoming a settled basis for action without a stated change.
records.operation: Identify the interpretation and use; distinguish conditional exploration, live consideration and operative reliance; specify permitted consequences and expiration or revision conditions.
records.end: A scoped commitment with permitted uses and revision conditions.
records.case: A retrieval interpretation directs a cue test without licensing a final diagnosis.
records.finding: Productive trial use does not require settled truth or final adoption.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective adoption correspondence
records.target: Determine whether observed distinctions and operations correspond to an agent's declared perspective in an identified context.
records.excludes: A diagnosis, a hidden true self, complete introspective access or truth of the declared account.
records.start: A stated perspective appears to diverge from subsequent conduct.
records.operation: Specify the declaration and expected operative difference; inspect the relevant conduct; identify agreement, discrepancy or insufficient evidence; preserve alternative explanations.
records.end: A scoped correspondence or discrepancy with evidence and unresolved explanations.
records.case: An agent promises an application-condition comparison but produces another general explanation.
records.finding: Declared, enacted and attributed perspectives can differ without establishing deception or pathology.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective candidate dimension construction
records.target: Construct a consequential distinction for organizing perspectives absent from the stated initial construction scheme.
records.excludes: Renaming an existing dimension or adding a label without a separating case.
records.start: Current candidates collapse cases requiring different continuations.
records.operation: Fix the old scheme; construct cases it treats alike but that require different contributions; identify the property, values and dependencies; compare with existing dimensions for duplication.
records.end: A candidate dimension with a separating case, values and explicit novelty scope.
records.case: Identical current method choices differ in whether recognition survives a wording change.
records.finding: Content and activation conditions vary independently in the constructed case.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective candidate space specification
records.target: Specify the perspectives constructible from declared dimensions, values and compatibility rules under a fixed identity convention.
records.excludes: All possible perspectives being captured or every combination being semantically adequate.
records.start: A growing candidate list lacks explicit construction boundaries.
records.operation: Declare dimensions and values; fix assignment identity; state incompatibility rules and grounds; identify whether the domain is finite and what it omits.
records.end: An explicit construction domain with identity and exclusion conditions.
records.case: Three interpretations, two representations and two commitments produce twelve assignments before exclusions.
records.finding: A construction space exposes omissions relative to its rules while leaving missing dimensions open.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective candidate space coverage
records.target: Determine whether a specified perspective inventory supplies required distinctions or contributions across every case of a declared domain.
records.excludes: Universal perspective completeness or coverage by one individual perspective.
records.start: All recorded candidates may still omit a consequential case.
records.operation: Fix cases and required contributions; map each case to a qualifying candidate or gap; preserve unknown adequacy; inspect gaps for missing values, dimensions or operations.
records.end: A scoped coverage result with gap witnesses and unresolved cases.
records.case: Content, retrieval and representation interpretations omit application-condition recognition in an altered case.
records.finding: Complete enumeration of current combinations can coexist with a substantive coverage gap.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective exploration exclusion justification
records.target: Determine whether an identified reason justifies excluding a candidate perspective from a specified exploration purpose and stage.
records.excludes: Permanent rejection, falsity of every candidate claim or final perspective selection.
records.start: An unfamiliar or conflicting perspective is removed before its contribution is examined.
records.operation: Recover candidate and reason; fix the exploration purpose; determine what the reason defeats; preserve useful conditional contributions; narrow, reverse or retain the exclusion.
records.end: A scoped justified exclusion, reinstatement or unresolved exclusion question.
records.case: An interpretation unsuitable for final reliance can still expose a useful missing condition when tried temporarily.
records.finding: Exclusion from action and exclusion from exploration can require different grounds.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective composition interference
records.target: Determine how combining perspectives impairs an identified contribution relative to their separately specified uses.
records.excludes: Mere component count, independent component failure or automatic incompatibility of different viewpoints.
records.start: Individually useful perspectives lose a needed distinction when combined.
records.operation: Fix the contribution; trace each perspective's assumptions, representations and commitments; identify the conflicting use; compare an arrangement preserving distinct roles.
records.end: An interference mechanism or unresolved interaction with a separating arrangement.
records.case: An exploratory assumption enters execution as established, losing its conditional standing.
records.finding: Composition must preserve contribution roles and status.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.

records.name: Perspective improvement transfer
records.target: Determine which conditions permit a previously established beneficial perspective change to contribute in a new setting.
records.excludes: Shared wording, retention only in the original setting or benefit in every related case.
records.start: A useful change is being applied beyond the conditions of its observed contribution.
records.operation: Fix the original contribution; map the new case; identify preserved and changed relevant relations; inspect the required operation and result; retain untested scope.
records.end: A justified transfer condition, failed mapping or unresolved new case.
records.case: Application-condition work transfers to another topic only if the relation governing appropriate use is preserved.
records.finding: A reusable transition can transfer while the earlier task answer does not.
records.standing: Authored definition and constructed separating case; empirical applicability remains scoped.
